title: GROMM: Generative Risk-neutral Option Market Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16732v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a statically and dynamically arbitrage-free European option market model with smooth interpolation between option prices, based on the SANOS framework, and prove that its dynamics admit a unique strong solution. In spirit, it is a stochastic model for local volatility when the latter is used as a representation of a European option price surface, not as a pricing model. We illustrate the strength of our approach on S&P Index Option data from January 2022 to August 2025. We show that the model's initial state fits within bid/ask for more than 95% of relevant market option prices. We then train the model dynamics under $\mathbb{P}$ and $\mathbb{Q}$ and show that the model is indeed free of arbitrage while fitting the dynamics of the market well. We also propose a range of BHW-tests to test for absence of arbitrage.

translated_title: GROMM：生成式风险中性期权市场模型
translated_abstract: 我们基于SANOS框架提出了一个静态和动态均无套利的欧式期权市场模型，该模型在期权价格之间具有平滑插值，并证明其动力学过程存在唯一强解。从本质上看，当局部波动率被用作欧式期权价格曲面的表示方式（而非作为定价模型）时，本模型是一个针对局部波动率的随机模型。我们在2022年1月至2025年8月的标普指数期权数据上展示了该方法的优势。结果表明，模型的初始状态能落在超过95%相关市场期权价格的买卖价差范围内。随后，我们在P测度和Q测度下训练模型动力学，并证明该模型确实无套利，同时能很好地拟合市场动态。我们还提出了一系列BHW检验来测试无套利性。
tldr: 基于SANOS框架提出了GROMM模型——一个静态和动态均无套利的生成式欧式期权市场模型，其初始状态能覆盖95%以上市场期权的买卖价差，并在P和Q两种测度下训练后验证了无套利性和对市场动态的良好拟合能力。
